label: Navigation
description: Manages application navigation, browser URLs, page stacks, and dialog or embedded page navigation.

src.description: Source URL of the current top-level x-page, or null if none exists.

stack.description: Snapshot of navigation stack entries containing href, params, and nav metadata.

xshell:navigation:start.description: Bus event emitted when top-level navigation begins.

xshell:navigation:end.description: Bus event emitted when the top-level page finishes loading.

replacePageQuery.description: Patches a page's query parameters, replacing the browser history entry when the page belongs to the navigation stack.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page instance with host and src.

parameters.name: changes
parameters.description: Query changes: scalars set a parameter, null deletes it, and undefined is ignored.

returns.description: Updated logical page URL, or null if no page source is available.

replacePageHash.description: Replaces a page URL fragment without reloading the page.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Fragment as a string, or null to remove it.

returns.description: Updated logical page URL, or null if unavailable.

buildUrlAbsolute.description: Builds an app-base-relative browser URL in path or hash navigation mode, unless the target is an absolute URL.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Navigation URL options, including href, params, nav, and optional page.

buildUrl.description: Builds a navigable logical URL, resolving relative href and serializing params and nav metadata.

navigate.description: Navigates to a page, stack entry, dialog, or embedded outlet. Dialog mode awaits and returns the dialog result; other modes normally resolve without a value.

returns.description: Promise; dialog mode resolves to the dialog result.
